_comment_scope: Visible only inside an ephemeral session. The unit bind-mounts this directory over /etc/opt/chrome/policies/managed, so a normal session on the same machine sees an empty directory and keeps every feature below.
_comment_model: The on-device model is around 3 GB. An ephemeral session starts from a fresh profile every connection, so it would download it again every connection, onto a tmpfs, and throw it away at disconnect. 1 = do not download. The spelling is GenAI with a capital I: GenAi... does not exist in the binary and a policy key Chrome does not recognise is ignored in silence.
_comment_firstrun: The first-run surfaces, which a fresh profile shows every time.
_comment_signin: Signing in would tie an account to a session that is about to be destroyed, and would leave the account's own history holding what was done in it.
